original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact_params as P
import active_quench as AQ

def construct_packing():
    # Seed with exact SA for 6 minutes, then active‑pair quench for 9 minutes
    centers, radii, score = AQ.run_sa_then_quench(P.exact_sa_params, sa_budget=360.0, quench_budget=540.0, seed=20251021)
    # Validity checks
    assert centers.shape == (26,2)
    assert radii.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(radii > 0)
    x, y = centers[:,0], centers[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(radii <= b + 1e-9)
    return centers, radii
